construction.score_explanation: The fit score includes graded suspend, time-counter, and exile interactions.

synergy.summary: Suspend spells on attack, turn waiting cards into power for Rose, and use time travel to choose when those spells come back.

highlights.title: Attack to suspend spells
highlights.description: The Doctor triggers once when you declare one or more attackers, even if he stays back. Start with cheap attackers and use repeatable suspend effects to keep spells waiting in exile. The list includes Jhoira of the Ghitu, The Eleventh Doctor, Inspiring Refrain.

highlights.title: Make time counters do two jobs
highlights.description: Keep suspended cards and other permanents with time counters to grow Rose on attack. When both attack triggers fire, resolve the Doctor's first so Rose can count the newly suspended card. Use time travel or a counter-removal effect to cast a suspended spell sooner. The list includes Time Beetle, Clockspinning, Kate Stewart.

highlights.title: Get more from spells cast out of exile
highlights.description: Once the final time counter comes off, cast the suspended spell and collect any cast-from-exile payoffs the list has in play. The list includes Passionate Archaeologist.

synergy.model: The original neural ranker compares each candidate with the commanders and the average features of the partial deck.

variants.title: Oracle mechanics
variants.change: Recognizes cards that grant suspend, accelerate suspended spells, or reward casting from exile. It gives overlapping free-casting effects less credit.

added: Uvilda, Dean of Perfection // Nassari, Dean of Expression

mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: Mean masked-context neural fit with adjustments for direct rules interactions. Higher scores rank ahead within this run.

synergy.summary: Suspend spells on attack, turn waiting cards into power for Rose, and use time travel to choose when those spells come back.

highlights.title: Attack to suspend spells
highlights.description: The Doctor triggers once when you declare one or more attackers, even if he stays back. Start with cheap attackers and use repeatable suspend effects to keep spells waiting in exile. The list includes Jhoira of the Ghitu, The Eleventh Doctor, Inspiring Refrain.

highlights.title: Make time counters do two jobs
highlights.description: Keep suspended cards and other permanents with time counters to grow Rose on attack. When both attack triggers fire, resolve the Doctor's first so Rose can count the newly suspended card. Use time travel or a counter-removal effect to cast a suspended spell sooner. The list includes Rotating Fireplace.

highlights.title: Get more from spells cast out of exile
highlights.description: Once the final time counter comes off, cast the suspended spell and collect any cast-from-exile payoffs the list has in play. The list includes Wild-Magic Sorcerer.

synergy.model: The experimental ranker also evaluates how each candidate relates to individual cards in the partial deck.

variants.title: Card-to-card model
variants.change: Uses a separately trained neural ranker that compares each candidate with individual cards in the partial deck. The original construction rules make the model change easier to see.

mana_diagnostics.interpretation: Native construction heuristic; lower risk is preferred. This is not an EDHPowerLevel percentage or a playtest result.

construction.score_explanation: The fit score includes graded suspend, time-counter, and exile interactions. Extra acceleration has diminishing value after eight sources.

synergy.summary: Suspend spells on attack, turn waiting cards into power for Rose, and use time travel to choose when those spells come back.

highlights.title: Attack to suspend spells
highlights.description: The Doctor triggers once when you declare one or more attackers, even if he stays back. Start with cheap attackers and use repeatable suspend effects to keep spells waiting in exile. The list includes Jhoira of the Ghitu, The Eleventh Doctor, Inspiring Refrain.

highlights.title: Make time counters do two jobs
highlights.description: Keep suspended cards and other permanents with time counters to grow Rose on attack. When both attack triggers fire, resolve the Doctor's first so Rose can count the newly suspended card. Use time travel or a counter-removal effect to cast a suspended spell sooner. The list includes Clockspinning, All of History, All at Once, Rotating Fireplace.

highlights.title: Get more from spells cast out of exile
highlights.description: Once the final time counter comes off, cast the suspended spell and collect any cast-from-exile payoffs the list has in play. The list includes Passionate Archaeologist, Wild-Magic Sorcerer.

synergy.model: The experimental ranker also evaluates how each candidate relates to individual cards in the partial deck.

variants.title: Combined experiment
variants.change: Applies the revised Oracle mechanics, diminishing returns for ramp, and the card-to-card neural ranker together.
